threshold_rule: Among thresholds whose validation recall meets val_recall_target_for_threshold, choose the one with the fewest validation false alarms; break ties by the largest margin, placing the threshold midway between the highest-scoring good image below it and the lowest-scoring defect at or above it. A score at or above the threshold means 'defect'.
threshold_rule_changed: 26 Oct 2026, before the test set was opened: the previous rule missed one validation defect with no reduction in false alarms.
